Run population-aware unbalanced optimal transport matching

Source: R/03_matching.R
run_uot_matching.Rd

Matches a query population and candidate cell-line population jointly within cancer lineage or across a global candidate pool using an entropically regularized unbalanced Sinkhorn algorithm. The raw transport plan is retained as `transport_mass`; row-normalized transport mass is reported as `matching_probability` and used to rank candidate cell lines for each query.

Usage

run_uot_matching(
  representation,
  metadata,
  candidate_scope = c("within_lineage", "global"),
  distance = c("euclidean", "manhattan", "cosine"),
  epsilon = 0.1,
  rho_query = 1,
  rho_cellline = 1,
  max_iter = 5000,
  tolerance = 1e-08
)

Arguments

representation

Numeric matrix with samples in rows and molecular features in columns; sample IDs must be row names.

metadata

Data frame containing `SampleID`, `SampleRole` and `lineage`.

candidate_scope

Either `"within_lineage"` or `"global"`.

distance

Distance metric: `"euclidean"`, `"manhattan"` or `"cosine"`. The default Euclidean cost is mean squared L2 distance divided by the number of retained PCs.

epsilon

Entropic regularization parameter.

rho_query

Query-population marginal-relaxation parameter.

rho_cellline

Cell-line marginal-relaxation parameter.

max_iter

Maximum Sinkhorn iterations.

tolerance

Convergence tolerance.

Value

A tibble containing candidate pairs, raw transport masses, row-normalized matching probabilities, molecular costs, ranks and uOT convergence information.
